For all odd p=2m+1>=5, the even induced facets reduce to T_a={a,a+1,a+m+1} mod p; there are p vertices, 2p edges, p triangles and one boundary p-cycle, with every vertex link a path, yielding a Mobius band. For a retraction onto even vertices, A_{2k} fixes the even edge and constrains the odd image to states x_k in {k,k+1,k+m+1}; A_{2k+1} permits only (0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(1,2),(2,0),(2,2). In a cyclic sequence any 0 forces all 0; absent 0 any 2 forces all 2; otherwise all 1. The three maps v↦v-1,v+1,v+p on odd vertices preserve every A_i,B_i and fix even vertices. Odd parity follows by translation. Hence exactly three for each band and H_1 split injectivity. Independently constructed parity complexes and exhaustively counted 3 retractions for each p=5,7,9,11; family proof is symbolic, not inferred from sample p.
